content.short: World App is the flagship mobile wallet for the World ecosystem, providing secure identity and UBI access now.
content.description: World App is the definitive self-custodial digital asset manager built for the World (formerly Worldcoin) ecosystem, designed to provide a secure and intuitive gateway to the decentralized web. The app serves as the primary portal for managing a user's World ID—a privacy-preserving digital identity verified via the "Orb" biometric device. World App allows participants to claim their regular Universal Basic Income (UBI) grants in the form of WLD tokens and interact with a growing array of decentralized financial tools, all while operating natively on the World Chain Layer 2.
content.meta: World App is the leading mobile wallet for the World ecosystem. Discover World App and other Web3 Wallets on the Lancers Web3 Explorer platform.
